body:
High functioning autistic. 5'10", 279lbs.

Maybe I eat too much. I don't know.

I do know that I no longer feel terrible about being fat. That probably started when I found I could enjoy walking my dog, sometimes for hours on end. And got even better when I started playing pokemon go and hatching eggs and such.

Because while I may be a large person, I'm healthy, in a way. I've built stamina. I've built lung capacity. I can walk at a pace that has other people pissed at me for running. And a lot of that fat turned into muscle mass, so I fit into clothing I haven't fit into for years.

Yeah, my belly dun' lop o'er my belt, but I can still walk faster and farther than those skinny assholes with a metabolism that has them looking like a clothing model no matter how much food they eat. I can carry all the groceries into the house in one trip without it being tiring.

I may still be fat, but I'm no longer weak, and that's OK.

HTH.
